# Agora miniapp SDK

Pinned npm package: agora-miniapp-sdk@2.6.5 (ISC metadata).
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/agora-miniapp-sdk/v/2.6.5
Official documentation: https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/rtc/mini-program/landing-page

agora-miniapp-sdk.js and its LICENSE.txt were copied unchanged from the pinned
npm archive on the isolated test runner using npm pack --ignore-scripts.
Keep the third-party notices alongside the SDK. No credentials are included.
Server AccessToken2 source is separately vendored under chat/internal/agoratoken
with its original MIT license from AgoraIO/Tools DynamicKey/AgoraDynamicKey/go.
